title: Diploma In Law (Level 3)
description: Build foundational knowledge of legal systems and principles for a pathway into legal practice or further legal study.
longDescription: This Diploma in Law introduces learners to essential legal concepts and practices across various branches of the legal system. Students will explore core topics such as contract law, criminal law, employment law, and torts, alongside developing academic and research skills tailored for legal study. The course provides a solid base for those aiming to pursue further legal education or enter the legal profession at an entry level. Time Table The programme runs from 26 October 2026 to 26 July 2027, covering six academic learning and assessment periods. Teaching includes guided lectures, practical activities, case studies, group discussions, independent study and assignment preparation. A Winter Vacation is scheduled from 21 December 2026 to 8 January 2027, followed by a Spring Vacation from 29 March to 16 April 2027. The final period focuses on assignment completion, assessment, quality assurance, academic review and confirmation of programme completion, with results processed in August 2027.
courseDetails: Modules include an introduction to law and practice, key principles of criminal and contract law, and practical insights into employment and tort law. Learners will also strengthen their academic and legal research abilities through targeted skill-building. The course encourages analytical thinking, legal reasoning, and understanding of real-world legal applications in various contexts.

entry: There are no formal entry requirements for this qualification.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

modules.title: Level 3 - Introduction To Law And Practice
modules.summary: This module provides a foundation in the structure, roles, and processes of the legal system. It explores key sources of law, the court hierarchy, and the roles of legal professionals in various legal contexts.

lessons.title: Unit 1-2 Legal system and Contract Law
Unit 3-4 Tort Law and Liability and Business Regulations and Compliance
Unit 5-6 Dispute Resolution and Legal Procedures and 6 Ethical Issues

modules.title: Level 3 - Principles Of Contract Law
modules.summary: Learners will study the formation, enforcement, and termination of contracts. The module focuses on legal rules governing agreement, consideration, capacity, and remedies for breach of contract.

lessons.title: Unit 1- 2 Contract Law and Legal Principles and Formation of Contracts
Unit 3-4 Terms of a Contract and Breach of Contract
Unit 5-6 Contractual Capacity and Agency and Contracts in Business Transactions

modules.title: Level 3 - Principles Of Criminal Law
modules.summary: This module introduces the fundamental concepts of criminal liability, examining offences such as theft, assault, and homicide. It covers actus reus, mens rea, and the role of defences in criminal cases.

lessons.title: Unit 1-2 Criminal Law and Justice Systems and Elements of Criminal Law
Unit 3-4 Categories of Criminal Offenses and Defenses in Criminal Law
Unit 4-5 The Role of Evidence in Criminal Proceedings and Ethical Considerations

modules.title: Level 3 - Introduction To Employment Law
modules.summary: Students explore the legal framework regulating the employment relationship. Topics include recruitment, contracts, discrimination, dismissal, and the rights and obligations of both employers and employees.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Employment Law
Unit 2 Employment Contracts and Terms
Unit 3 Employee Rights and Responsibilities
Unit 4 Discrimination and Equal Opportunities in the Workplace

modules.title: Level 3 - Aspects Of Tort Law
modules.summary: Focusing on civil wrongs, this module covers the key principles of tort law, including negligence, occupiers' liability, and nuisance. It examines how liability is established and the remedies available.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Tort Law
Unit 2-3 Negligence and Liability and Nuisance and Trespass
Unit 4-5 Defamation and Protection of Reputation and Remedies in Tort Law

modules.title: Level 3 - Academic And Research Skills For Law
modules.summary: This module develops core legal research, writing, and referencing skills. Learners will engage with legal texts, case law, and statutory materials to build effective academic and analytical skills.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Fundamentals of Research
Unit 2 Academic Writing Skills
Unit 3 Study and Time Management Skills
Unit 4 Research Methods and Tools

outcomes: Demonstrate an understanding of the structure, functions, and sources of law within the legal system.
Explain the essential elements of a valid contract and apply legal principles to resolve contractual disputes.
Describe the key principles of criminal liability and apply them to analyze basic criminal cases.
Identify the rights and responsibilities of employers and employees within the framework of employment law.
Analyze legal duties and liabilities in tort, including negligence and duty of care.
Apply academic and legal research skills to source, interpret, and present legal information effectively.
